changes: Replace MemorySpillAdapter full-map byte summation with an incremental byte ledger.
Update the ledger only after a successful buffer copy and map update; subtract removed entry size only when deletion succeeds.

edge_cases: rejected replacement preserves old bytes and usage

spill_lifecycle_finding.evidence: SpillAdapter.write accepts caller-selected ids; MemorySpillAdapter replaces an existing entry at the same id. Query/window spill call sites check cancellation after writes settle.
spill_lifecycle_finding.implication: Unconditional deletion after a cancelled write cannot safely restore an overwritten checkpoint or distinguish another writer. Transactional/staged or conditional adapter semantics are required before adding rollback cleanup.
spill_lifecycle_finding.status: Transactional cancellation cleanup remains open; this commit does not alter write/delete semantics.

limits: Spill bytes accounting describes stored payload bytes, not query allocation pools or total heap.
The benchmark models previous map-scanning accounting with local 8-byte writes; no disk/cloud latency claim.
remaining: Transactional spill lifecycle and complete spill/resume allocation integration
Mixed-job runtime headroom and final release acceptance
